messages.subject: Solved the issue on labels
parts:
Hi  all,

I was able to solve the Xaxis label issue by using a larger png PRINT output and high res.
When I tried 850 x 850 px it only printed a small part of the actual plot and did not scale it up in size as expected.

So i had to go back to 600 x 600 and it prints the plot fine and very legible text.

Thanks also to baptiste for the temp. fix in the Y axis label not being centered.
